Border.doc: A border of a box, comprised of four sides: top, right, bottom, left.

BorderRadius.doc: An immutable set of radii for each corner of a rectangle.

BorderSide.doc: A side of a border of a box.

GaugeChartData.doc: [GaugeChart] needs this class to render itself.

GaugeMarker.doc:
A single marker drawn along the gauge's arc at an arbitrary
continuous [value]. Conceptually a continuous-value cousin of
[GaugeTicks] — markers reference the ring stack as a whole (outer /
inner / center) and use the same arc-anchored local frame as
[GaugeTickPainter], but each carries its own `value` instead of
being constrained to an evenly-spaced index.

GaugePointer.doc:
A single pointer drawn on top of the gauge, indicating a specific
[value] on the scale shared by [GaugeChartData.rings].

GaugeRing.doc: Base type for a single concentric ring of a [GaugeChartData].

GaugeTickPainter.doc: Interface for rendering a single tick mark on a [GaugeChart].

GaugeTicks.doc: Configuration for tick marks drawn along a [GaugeChartData]'s arc.

GaugeZone.doc:
A single colored band within a [GaugeZonesRing]. [from] and [to]
are positions on the shared [GaugeChartData.minValue] /
[GaugeChartData.maxValue] scale; [to] must be `>= from`.

GradientTransform.doc:

ViewPadding.doc:
A representation of distances for each of the four edges of a rectangle,
used to encode the view insets and padding that applications should place
around their user interface, as exposed by [FlutterView.viewInsets] and
[FlutterView.padding]. View insets and padding are preferably read via
[MediaQuery.of].
